digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatch and bridge subcommand group
propositions: Implement nested `rebar bridge` CLI group exposing only `preview` (read-only, dry-run) and `sync` (mutating, live) verbs while preserving all legacy top-level command spellings unchanged.
Reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and arbitrary trailing arguments on both bridge verbs to prevent caller override of the read/write distinction.

Preview verb must perform zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes; sync verb must perform persisted mutations from production-shaped fake Jira fixtures while preserving unrelated state bytes.

Unknown nested verbs must fail with valid choices and never fall through to same-named top-level commands; nested verb help must exclude internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, numeric exit codes).

Update CLI reference generation and documentation (cli-reference.md, exit-codes.md, user-guide.md, release-notes.md) to describe only the staged bridge surface that ships without exposing broken placeholders.
Maintain backward compatibility: Mode, MODE_CAPS, gated_mode reconcile-check round trip, top-level doctor, and all legacy bridge spellings remain functional and exercised by existing test suites.
